SPRING.name: Tagsibol (Spring)
SPRING.description: Sariwang hangin at mabilis na pagtubo ng kalikasan. Normal na panahon.
SPRING.descriptionEn: Fresh winds and gentle renewal. Balanced conditions across the realm.

SUMMER.name: Tag-araw (Summer)
SUMMER.description: Mataas na sikat ng araw at matinding init. Madalas ang Heatwave.
SUMMER.descriptionEn: Blazing sun and sweltering temperatures. Higher heatwave frequency.

AUTUMN.name: Taglagas (Autumn)
AUTUMN.description: Malamig na simoy at pagkalagas ng dahon. Madalas ang malalakas na ulan.
AUTUMN.descriptionEn: Crisp breezes and falling foliage. Frequent rainfalls and storms.

WINTER.name: Taglamig (Winter)
WINTER.description: Napakalamig na hamog at yelo. Madalas ang pag-ulan ng niyebe.
WINTER.descriptionEn: Freezing temperatures and frostbite. Heavy snowfalls throughout.
